question: For these TCGA cohorts and their tissues of origin: liver hepatocellular carcinoma (liver), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (kidney), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (pancreas), lung adenocarcinoma (lung), breast invasive carcinoma (breast), colon adenocarcinoma (colon), stomach adenocarcinoma (stomach), prostate adenocarcinoma (prostate), ovary serous cystadenocarcinoma (ovary), thyroid carcinoma (thyroid gland), glioblastoma multiforme (brain), testicular germ cell tumor (testis): give the number of validated favourable and validated unfavourable prognostic genes, and how many of each are tissue enriched in the tissue of origin. Draw a grouped bar chart of the four counts per cohort and provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query":"WITH cohort_tissue AS (
    SELECT 'Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AS Cancer, 'liver' AS tissue UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'kidney' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'pancreas' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'lung' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'breast' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'colon' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'stomach 1' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'prostate' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'ovary' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Thyroid Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'thyroid gland' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)', 'brain' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TCGA)', 'testis'
)
SELECT 
    ct.Cancer,
    ct.tissue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN c.Gene END) AS val_fav,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' THEN c.Gene END) AS val_unfav,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - favorable" != '' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specificity" = 'Tissue enriched' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specific nTPM" LIKE ct.tissue || ':%' 
                        THEN c.Gene END) AS val_fav_enriched,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specificity" = 'Tissue enriched' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specific nTPM" LIKE ct.tissue || ':%' 
                        THEN c.Gene END) AS val_unfav_enriched
FROM cohort_tissue ct
LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data c ON ct.Cancer = c.Cancer
LEFT JOIN proteinatlas p ON c.Gene = p.Ensembl
GROUP BY ct.Cancer, ct.tissue
ORDER BY ct.Cancer"}

WITH cohort_tissue AS (
    SELECT 'Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)' AS Cancer, 'liver' AS tissue UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'kidney' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'pancreas' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'lung' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'breast' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'colon' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'stomach 1' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'prostate' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (TCGA)', 'ovary' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Thyroid Carcinoma (TCGA)', 'thyroid gland' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)', 'brain' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TCGA)', 'testis'
)
SELECT 
    ct.Cancer,
    ct.tissue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - favorable" != '' THEN c.Gene END) AS val_fav,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' THEN c.Gene END) AS val_unfav,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - favorable" != '' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specificity" = 'Tissue enriched' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specific nTPM" LIKE ct.tissue || ':%' 
                        THEN c.Gene END) AS val_fav_enriched,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."validated prognostic - unfavorable" != '' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specificity" = 'Tissue enriched' 
                         AND p."RNA tissue specific nTPM" LIKE ct.tissue || ':%' 
                        THEN c.Gene END) AS val_unfav_enriched
FROM cohort_tissue ct
LEFT JOIN cancer_prognostic_data c ON ct.Cancer = c.Cancer
LEFT JOIN proteinatlas p ON c.Gene = p.Ensembl
GROUP BY ct.Cancer, ct.tissue
ORDER BY ct.Cancer

### Key Observations
1. **Kidney clear cell carcinoma** and **liver hepatocellular carcinoma** have substantial numbers of validated favorable prognostic genes that are specifically **tissue-enriched** in their organ of origin (16 in kidney and 45 in liver, respectively), reflecting normal differentiated tissue functions whose preservation correlates with improved patient survival.
2. Across all 12 cohorts, **none** of the validated unfavorable prognostic genes are tissue-enriched in the corresponding normal tissue of origin.
3. Four cohorts (Stomach adenocarcinoma, Prostate adenocarcinoma, Thyroid carcinoma, and Testicular germ cell tumor) do not have validated prognostic genes identified in this release.
